name: Emoji Keyboard
description:
😄🐘🎮🍎🚀
Every emoji, one click away 😀 Click an emoji and it's copied: paste it in any app or website 📋
Make your chats, posts, emails and comments more fun on any website: find any emoji by word, keep your favourites at hand, or build a whole message and copy it in one click 💬
Right-click any page to open it, or pop it out in its own window, and in our chat apps the emoji goes straight into the message box ✨
Light and fast: it uses your system's own emojis, up to the newest Unicode 17.0, so it opens instantly 🚀

FEATURES
✔ 1,700+ emojis in 9 categories, with search by word 🔎
✔ Frequently used emojis always at hand (right-click › Delete to remove one) ⌛
✔ Build a whole message in the box and copy it all in one click 📝
✔ Super Emojis: the newest emojis in a tab of their own 🤣
✔ Works with our chat apps: their emoji button puts the emoji right in the message box 💬
✔ Right-click any page › Open Emoji Keyboard, or pop it out in its own window 🖱️
✔ Light: no images to download, easy on CPU and RAM 🍃

PREMIUM FEATURES
🚨 App Booster 🚨
🐗 Support Oinkandstuff

📌 This extension includes promotion to other Oinkandstuff extensions to increase awareness of other work that we produce, you may find some very useful 😀 All our extensions are free to use and available online 📌

REQUIRED PERMISSIONS
————————————————————

You may consult the list of permissions and the reason why they are required on the product page: https://www.oinkandstuff.com/project/emoji-keyboard/#permissions

“notifications” – Used to send desktop notifications. For example when a new message arrives or the App is updated.
“contextMenus” – Allows adding more settings when you right-click the App icon in the browser toolbar and in the browser context menu, for example to open links in the App when you right-click them.
“storage” – Used to save settings on your local computer.
“scripting” – Used to be able to insert JS or CSS on the required host/domains: it puts the emoji you pick right in the message box of the page, for example when you open Emoji Keyboard from the emoji button of our chat Apps.
“system.display” – Used to detect the display size and position the Extension window (the Emoji Keyboard window that opens next to our chat Apps, from the right-click menu or when you pop it out).
“unlimitedStorage” – Storage is limited to 5MB of data that may not be enough to store all configs.
“host_permissions” – Permission to access some hosts/domains that we must modify in order to provide the desired functionality detailed above. It also allows you to share content (links or text) from other pages directly inside the App. Also used to allow intercommunication with other Oinkandstuff Apps (i.e. the emoji button of our chat Apps).
“activeTab” – Permission to access the window where the Extension is running and that is shown to the user, for example to put the emoji you pick in the page you are using.
“tabs” – Permission required to query all the active tabs in order to put the emoji on the requested tab.
“all_urls” – We must have access to all hosts/domains in order to inject Emojis on the user target webpage text input.
“webRequest” & “webRequestBlocking” – Used to intercept some requests and adjust their headers on the page where you are writing, so that Emoji Keyboard can put the emoji in the message box of any website or App (including our chat Apps).
